newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo wants sell-off to go ahead soon.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo wants sell-off to go ahead soon.

text.p: Italy's largest bank San Paolo di Torino wants to go ahead with its privatisation as soon as possible to catch the current favourable conditions in the Milan stock market, said the group's chairman Gianni Zandano.
"I would like to go ahead as soon as possible. If not the favourable conditions of the market could pass," he said, while attending a conference here.

San Paolo is held 65 percent by a foundation with the rest of the shares quoted on the Milan stock market. At the end of January, the bank announced plans to float a further 45 percent of its shares on the stock market. This would include 20 percent to private investors and 25 percent in a public share offer.
